nodes.description: Address of the current contract owner; controls onlyOwner privileged functions.
Pending owner address used by the two-step ownership transfer.
ERC20 token symbol string, set to 'BCX' in the constructor.
ERC20 token name string, set to 'Basecoin' in the constructor.
Token decimals, fixed to 18 (uint8).
Total token supply, assigned 100000000000000000000000 at construction.
mapping(address => uint) of token balances; mutated by transfer and transferFrom.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) of allowances; mutated by approve and approveAndCall.
Owned constructor that assigns owner = msg.sender.
onlyOwner function that stages a new owner in newOwner.
Completes ownership transfer when called by newOwner; resets newOwner to zero.
BCX constructor that mints the full supply to a hardcoded address.
Returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] using unchecked arithmetic.
Returns the balance of tokenOwner from the balances mapping.
Moves tokens from msg.sender to 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd on balances.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens without a return-value check.
Moves tokens from 'from' to 'to' while decrementing the caller allowance.
Returns the remaining allowance for spender over tokenOwner funds.
Sets allowance then calls the spender contract's receiveApproval callback.
Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts to reject ETH.
onlyOwner rescue that calls transfer on an arbitrary ERC20 contract.
Checked addition guarded by require(c >= a).
Checked subtraction guarded by require(b <= a).
Checked multiplication guarded by a == 0 || c / a == b.
Checked division guarded by require(b > 0).
msg.sender read in the Owned constructor to initialize owner.
msg.sender compared with newOwner in acceptOwnership.
msg.sender used as the acting account in approve, transfer, transferFrom and approveAndCall.
Checked addition a + b inside safeAdd; overflow prevented by post-condition require.
Checked subtraction a - b inside safeSub; underflow prevented by require(b <= a).
Checked multiplication a * b inside safeMul; overflow prevented by division check.
Division a / b inside safeDiv; divide-by-zero prevented by require(b > 0).
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) made after allowance state write; reentrancy vector.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) on an arbitrary, attacker-supplied token contract.
Raw unchecked subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] using native uint arithmetic instead of safeSub.
Payable fallback that executes revert(), rejecting direct ETH transfers.
Destination address of BCX.transfer.
User-controlled token amount for BCX.transfer.
Spender address being granted an allowance in BCX.approve.
Allowance amount granted in BCX.approve.
Source account of BCX.transferFrom.
Destination account of BCX.transferFrom.
Token amount debited in BCX.transferFrom.
Contract address that will be granted an allowance and then called back.
Allowance amount granted in BCX.approveAndCall.
Raw bytes payload forwarded to the spender's receiveApproval callback.
Arbitrary ERC20 contract address whose transfer is invoked by the owner.
Amount of foreign tokens the owner rescues.
Candidate address staged as the pending owner.
Address whose balance is queried.
Owner address of the queried allowance.
Spender address of the queried allowance.
Boolean return value of BCX.transfer, always set to true.
Named return variable holding the queried balance.
Named return variable holding the queried remaining allowance.

edges.reason: Owned constructor derives the privileged owner directly from msg.sender.
acceptOwnership authorises the caller by comparing msg.sender with newOwner.
Caller identity selects the balances entry debited by transfer.
Caller identity keys the allowance slot written by approve.
Caller identity keys the allowance slot consumed by transferFrom.
Caller identity keys the allowance slot written before the callback in approveAndCall.
Constructor writes msg.sender into the owner state variable.
onlyOwner stages the caller-supplied address into newOwner.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into owner, rotating privileges.
acceptOwnership clears newOwner to address(0) after the transfer.
Constructor initialises the symbol string.
Constructor initialises the name string.
Constructor initialises the decimals value.
Constructor fixes the total supply.
Constructor mints the whole supply to a single hardcoded address.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] to exclude burned tokens.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping for the queried account.
transfer reads and writes sender and recipient balances.
approve writes the nested allowed mapping entry.
transferFrom debits the source balance and credits the destination balance.
transferFrom decrements the spender allowance in the allowed mapping.
allowance reads the nested allowed mapping entry.
approveAndCall writes the allowance before interacting with the spender.
onlyOwner reads owner both as the privilege check and as the rescue recipient.
transfer routes the sender balance debit through safeSub.
transfer routes the recipient balance credit through safeAdd.
transferFrom routes the source balance and allowance debits through safeSub.
transferFrom routes the destination balance credit through safeAdd.
totalSupply performs raw uint subtraction without the SafeMath helpers.
Allowance state is written and then an external call is made to the spender contract.
Owner-only rescue performs an external call into a caller-supplied token contract.
safeAdd body performs the checked addition operation.
safeSub body performs the checked subtraction operation.
safeMul body performs the checked multiplication operation.
safeDiv body performs the guarded division operation.
Fallback function body immediately executes revert().
transfer calls safeSub for the balance arithmetic.
transfer calls safeAdd for the balance arithmetic.
transferFrom calls safeSub twice for balance and allowance arithmetic.
transferFrom calls safeAdd for the destination credit.
The spender contract's receiveApproval executes while approveAndCall is still active, enabling reentrancy.
The arbitrary token contract can re-enter the rescue path during its transfer call.
safeSub result is stored back into the balances mapping.
safeAdd result is stored back into the balances mapping.
User-supplied token amount is the subtrahend of the balance debit.
User-supplied token amount is the addend of the balance credit.
User-supplied destination address indexes the credited balance slot.
User-supplied source address indexes the debited balance slot in transferFrom.
User-supplied destination address indexes the credited balance slot in transferFrom.
User-supplied amount is the subtrahend of the transferFrom debits.
User-supplied amount is the addend of the transferFrom credit.
User-supplied spender address keys the nested allowance mapping.
User-supplied amount is stored as the allowance value.
User-supplied spender address becomes the target of the external callback.
User-supplied spender address keys the allowance slot written before the call.
User-supplied amount is stored as the allowance value in approveAndCall.
User-supplied bytes payload is forwarded verbatim to the spender callback.
User-supplied token address becomes the callee of the external transfer.
User-supplied amount is passed as the transfer argument.
Caller-supplied address is staged as the future owner.
Queried address keys the balances mapping lookup.
Queried owner address keys the allowance mapping lookup.
Queried spender address keys the allowance mapping lookup.
transfer assigns its boolean return value.
balanceOf assigns its named return variable from the balances lookup.
allowance assigns its named return variable from the allowed lookup.

normalization_plan.reason: Destination address parameter is consumed only by BCX.transfer for the balance credit.
Token amount parameter is consumed only by BCX.transfer as the arithmetic operand.
Spender parameter exists solely to key the allowance write in BCX.approve.
Amount parameter exists solely as the allowance value written by BCX.approve.
Source address parameter is used only for the balance debit in BCX.transferFrom.
Destination address parameter is used only for the balance credit in BCX.transferFrom.
Amount parameter is used only as the arithmetic operand in BCX.transferFrom.
Spender parameter is used only to key the allowance and target the callback in BCX.approveAndCall.
Amount parameter is used only as the allowance value in BCX.approveAndCall.
Data parameter is used only as the callback payload in BCX.approveAndCall.
Token address parameter is used only as the external callee in BCX.transferAnyERC20Token.
Amount parameter is used only as the external call argument in BCX.transferAnyERC20Token.
New owner parameter is used only to write the newOwner slot in Owned.transferOwnership.
Queried address parameter is used only for the balances lookup in BCX.balanceOf.
Owner address parameter is used only for the allowance lookup in BCX.allowance.
Spender address parameter is used only for the allowance lookup in BCX.allowance.
Local return flag is created and returned entirely within BCX.transfer.
Local named return value is created and returned entirely within BCX.balanceOf.
Local named return value is created and returned entirely within BCX.allowance.
